report.provenance: Synthetic delayed classification labels; independent historical baseline.

state.guarantee_scope: Lifetime family false-opening probability under independent stationary bounded observations and noninformative label arrival; not universal drift detection.

report.calibration: 512 historical labeled examples per segment from a separate random stream; no threshold tuning on evaluation seeds.
limitations: Family guarantee assumes independent stationary bounded observations and independent historical calibration.
Label-delay/availability must be noninformative for population-quality interpretation.
Mean-shift monitoring does not detect all distribution changes; no guaranteed detection delay.
The stationary empirical interval is broad at this bounded trial count; zero observed alerts is not zero risk.
Alpha is never replenished after alerts; very late changes face increasingly conservative thresholds.
report.provenance: Synthetic independent trajectories; simulated classification outcomes and noninformative label delays.
